name: Corporate Online
summary: Perth ISP offering dialup and web development services (Corporate Online Pty Ltd); 4 Stack Street, White Gum Valley/Fremantle WA; tagline 'Your online technology partner'; product 'Corporate Private Network (CPN)'; closed 7 March 2001.

events.details: Listed in 1997 APNIC IP subnet list with three sub-allocations within Telstra's 203.36.0.0/14 block (203.38.39.0/25, 203.38.63.128/26, 203.38.74.128/26); 4 Stack Street, White Gum Valley WA; Technical Director Michael Russell; earliest Wayback capture Jan 1999; services included dialup, web development, and 'Corporate Private Network (CPN)'.
Website announced closure: 'Sadly Corporate Online closed it's doors on 7th March 2001 and has ceased trading.' Last Wayback capture Dec 2001.
